offline_only_parameters.name: bag_path
offline_only_parameters.description: [Offline node only] ROS bag path to process (required)

offline_only_parameters.name: skip_to_time
offline_only_parameters.description: [Offline node only] Skip to timestamp in the bag (seconds)

configurable_parameters.name: imu_topic
configurable_parameters.description: IMU input topic (required)

configurable_parameters.name: lidar_topic
configurable_parameters.description: LiDAR pointcloud topic (required)

configurable_parameters.name: imu_frame
configurable_parameters.description: IMU frame, can be left empty if message frame id is to be used

configurable_parameters.name: lidar_frame
configurable_parameters.description: LiDAR frame, can be left empty if message frame id is to be used

configurable_parameters.name: base_frame
configurable_parameters.description: Robot base frame, or the frame of estimation for odometry (required)

configurable_parameters.name: odom_frame
configurable_parameters.description: Odom frame id, used for publishing the tf from base frame to odom frame

configurable_parameters.name: odom_topic
configurable_parameters.description: Odometry topic name

configurable_parameters.name: invert_odom_tf
configurable_parameters.description: Invert odometry transform if required so that the base frame is the parent and odom frame is the child in the TF tree

configurable_parameters.name: publish_local_map
configurable_parameters.description: Publish local map

configurable_parameters.name: map_topic
configurable_parameters.description: Local map topic. Published if publish_local_map is true

configurable_parameters.name: publish_map_after
configurable_parameters.description: Seconds between each local map publishing

configurable_parameters.name: publish_lidar_acceleration
configurable_parameters.description: Publish the linear acceleration of the `base_frame` expressed in `base_frame` coordinates. Note that this acceleration can be quite noisy, as it is essentially a double time derivative of the pose update from the lidar scan registration (similar to the twist/velocity in the odometry topic). The topic name is /rko_lio/lidar_acceleration.

configurable_parameters.name: deskew
configurable_parameters.description: Deskew the point cloud before registration, requires timestamps in the Lidar messages

configurable_parameters.name: voxel_size
configurable_parameters.description: Voxel size for the local map (meters) used for odometry

configurable_parameters.name: max_points_per_voxel
configurable_parameters.description: Max points per voxel

configurable_parameters.name: max_range
configurable_parameters.description: Max valid LiDAR range (meters)

configurable_parameters.name: min_range
configurable_parameters.description: Min valid LiDAR range (meters)

configurable_parameters.name: max_correspondance_distance
configurable_parameters.description: ICP correspondence distance threshold (meters)

configurable_parameters.name: convergence_criterion
configurable_parameters.description: Optimization stopping condition for ICP

configurable_parameters.name: max_num_threads
configurable_parameters.description: Number of threads used for data association in ICP

configurable_parameters.name: publish_deskewed_scan
configurable_parameters.description: Publish deskewed scan for visualization

configurable_parameters.name: initialization_phase
configurable_parameters.description: Use the IMU data between the first two frames to initialize IMU bias and system orientation. Assumes the system is at rest between these two frames. WARNING: If this is enabled, but the odometry starts while the system is in motion, the odometry will likely not work as expected. But I highly recommended enabling this while ensuring the system starts from rest.

configurable_parameters.name: max_iterations
configurable_parameters.description: Max ICP iterations

configurable_parameters.name: max_expected_jerk
configurable_parameters.description: Max expected jerk (m/s^3)

configurable_parameters.name: double_downsample
configurable_parameters.description: Double downsample the input cloud before registration. Useful for dense Lidars. Can be disabled for sparse lidars.

configurable_parameters.name: min_beta
configurable_parameters.description: Scale parameter that decides the minimum amount of orientation regularisation applied during ICP registration.

configurable_parameters.name: lts_multiplier_to_seconds
configurable_parameters.description: Multiplier to convert per-point raw timestamps to seconds. Default 0.0 tries to automatically handle seconds or nanoseconds. Specify for any other, e.g., if timestamps are in microseconds, set to 1e-6.

configurable_parameters.name: lts_force_absolute
configurable_parameters.description: Force treat per-point timestamps as absolute times (wall-clock), bypassing heuristic detection.

configurable_parameters.name: lts_force_relative
configurable_parameters.description: Force treat per-point timestamps as offsets relative to each message's header time.

configurable_parameters.name: lts_absolute_start_threshold_ms
configurable_parameters.description: Heuristic for absolute times: if abs(header_time - min per-point timestamp) < this value (in ms), treat times as absolute.

configurable_parameters.name: lts_absolute_end_threshold_ms
configurable_parameters.description: Heuristic for absolute times: if abs(header_time - max per-point timestamp) < this value (in ms), treat times as absolute.

configurable_parameters.name: lts_relative_start_threshold_ms
configurable_parameters.description: Heuristic for relative times: if abs(min per-point timestamp) < this value (in ms), consider times as relative.

configurable_parameters.name: lts_relative_end_threshold_ms
configurable_parameters.description: Heuristic for relative times: If abs(max per-point timestamp) < this value, consider times as relative.

configurable_parameters.name: mode
configurable_parameters.description: Launch mode: 'offline' or 'online'

configurable_parameters.name: config_file
configurable_parameters.description: YAML config file to load parameters from

configurable_parameters.name: dump_results
configurable_parameters.description: Dump the odometry configuration and trajectory to a <results_dir>/<run_name> folder. The folder name includes an index that is incremented automatically to prevent accidental overwrites.

configurable_parameters.name: results_dir
configurable_parameters.description: When the odometry node exists, this is the folder used for dumping odometry configuration and trajectory up to that point. See `dump_results` which has to be true.

configurable_parameters.name: run_name
configurable_parameters.description: Run name, used when saving results to <results_dir>. See `dump_results` which has to be true.

configurable_parameters.name: rviz
configurable_parameters.description: Launch RViz simultaneously

configurable_parameters.name: rviz_config_file
configurable_parameters.description: RViz config file path. If it's not the default value, note that it will be passed to rviz as is.

configurable_parameters.name: log_level
configurable_parameters.description: ROS Log level [DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL]
